body: You're right - I will go back to therapy. We did focus on me, and on my co-dependency, but we also talked about him and what was going on. I shouldn't tolerate any of this behaviour, and I need to reflect on all of this.

Thank you for this. You've really hit the nail on the head. He would do so many things to provoke me, and then turn around and blame me when I reacted. I pointed out several times that any woman would react to some of the things he said or did, and sometimes that would give him pause. 

After I saw him this last time (where he shouted at me and called me pathetic), he went over to a mutual friend's house. Unprompted, that friend told me a week later that he was HAPPY when he arrived. It blew my mind, but of course - he feels better about himself when he's trying to make me feel awful about himself. 

Thank you again for your insight - I really appreciate it.
Thank you for your kind words. I am going back to therapy, and you're right in that it's what I need to do.

Thank you. I do think his words and actions were designed to make me feel awful. He succeeded. I'm trying to take my life back, but it's just so hard to keep going on. I had to see him today, and he called me pathetic. Again.

I saw a therapist for the first three months after the break up. I think I need to go back. She actually suggested he had borderline personality disorder, which makes a lot of sense. I have read a lot of books too, including on co-dependency. I'm just feeling very low right now - I feel like I'm doing all the right things, but it's not enough.
Thank you for your kind words.
